method: Read AGENTS.md and START-HERE.md. Used mapping paths for all four exact published candidates. Independently decoded every frame at actual duration, recomputed motion/seam/mask metrics, and verified SHA-256 before and after review. Inspected original artwork, full-scene sampled frames, native source/motion/seam crops, and enlarged Gryffindor details with view_image.
limitations: Sampled still-frame visual review; no continuous full-speed viewing or subjective audio audition.
Verdicts apply only to listed hashes and do not grade integrated product readiness.

scenes.scope: Exact-hash sampled visuals and independent full decode; no continuous playback or audio audition
findings: The broad window masks blend a displaced generated skyline over the original. Cathedral spires, foreground roofs and bridge details have visible second silhouettes/soft doubled edges in source-versus-frame0,24,48,72 comparisons. This is compositing ghosting rather than fine rain passing in front of a stable city.
Books, foreground lamp, desk and window mullions remain stationary in sampled full-scene frames. Tea steam is restrained, but does not compensate for the broad exterior ghosting.

All168 frames decode. Independently measured seam-to-typical change4.2986 exceeds the current new-film criterion of <4. Endpoint comparisons also show a rain/sky brightness difference. Continuous playback was not assessed.
requiredChanges: Remove generated skyline displacement. Isolate rain from rigid buildings or retain original skyline with a separate geometry-safe rain treatment. Correct the loop seam and independently review the replacement hash.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience after correction.

scenes.scope: Exact-hash sampled visuals and independent full decode; no continuous playback or audio audition
findings: The sleeping cat beneath the chair loses its crisp source silhouette: frames0/24/48/72 show a smeared alternate head/body position over the original. Fur and face blend into a translucent blur rather than a convincing restrained breathing motion.

Stove fire, subtle cup steam and lantern glow remain localized in sampled images. Doorway, mountain landscape, books and furniture stay fixed. Preserve these clean regions while restoring the original static cat.
All168 frames decode, seam ratio2.6180. Sampled stove seam shows coherent fire progression; this is not a full-speed smoothness assessment.
requiredChanges: Freeze the cat to its original source geometry or replace the cat animation with a convincingly aligned treatment. Retain independently clean stove/steam motion; review replacement hash.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience after correction.

scenes.scope: Exact-hash sampled visuals and independent full decode; no continuous playback or audio audition
findings: Enlarged native crops reveal an offset translucent flame/shaft beside the left wall candle, particularly frames0/24/48. The source has one crisp candle; blending a relocated generated flame creates a ghosted companion.

The hearth fire is lively and contained, but the overlapping fire-screen region softens and displaces the left ornamental posts and horizontal bar compared with the source. Preserve the rigid screen geometry when retaining the fire. The cat changes shape subtly but does not show the severe split seen in Howls.
All168 frames decode, seam ratio1.1653. Room furniture, window and stairs remain stable in sampled full-scene frames. The favorable seam number does not eliminate the compositing defects.
requiredChanges: Preserve the original left candle geometry and the rigid fire-screen bars. Restrict generated fire to open flame regions behind the screen, or otherwise exclude screen geometry; independently review replacement hash.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience after correction.

correctionGuidance.coordinateSpace: 1280x720 decoded video; original source coordinates multiply by1672/1280

Keep left ornamental lion/post roughly x178..219,y334..428 and right post near x405..435,y336..439 static.
Candidate upper-flame polygon is a conservative inspection starting point, not an approved final mask; feathering must not reach screen/post geometry.
Keep wall candles original or geometry-safe; do not alpha-blend shifted generated shafts.

scenes.scope: Exact-hash sampled visuals and independent full decode; no continuous playback or audio audition
findings: The revised571cbc... film still blends displaced building geometry under its rectangular rain masks. The left high-rise acquires offset windows and a broad doubled silhouette; the central tower, railway and storefront edges also become softened or doubled. These are visible in every sampled motion row versus the source.

The Tokyo tower outside the main mask, room furniture, sleeping cat and mug remain fixed. Steam is subtle. The rain regions must exclude rigid skyline/railway geometry or use an independently isolated rain layer; their present names do not describe their full visual effect.
